messages:
anya: FYI premerge gpu-smoke for #4287 is red on a few shards, looks like driver/runtime skew? https://ci.redwood/4287
ci-bot: Job gpu-smoke/fast (shard 3) failed: exit 1. Logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/4287/3
matt: can you paste the failing error from the log? quick glance helps triage.
sylvia: paste from the container startup where cuda init happens:
```
[2026-03-17 09:12:43] cuda init: driver: 535.101, libcuda: 540.2
E tensorflow: cudaErrorIllegalAddress: invalid device memory access
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/smoke/test_infer.py", line 28, in <module>
    run_smoke()
cudaErrorIllegalAddress
```
anya: thanks. i also saw a kernel message in node 4: "NVRM: Xid 79" right before the fail — not sure if HW or driver.
matt: driver 535 vs libcuda 540 mismatch is suspicious. infra-bot, did we roll drivers on fleet last night? :eyes:
infra-bot: driver-rollout job completed 2026-03-16T23:40Z. Rolled 535.101 -> 540.2 on us-west-2-gpu-pool-2.
raj: ok that explains it. some images in CI still have older runtime linked to 535 and the host driver is 540 now — that produces illegal address errors.
anya: quick ask — can someone rerun the failed shard with the pinned driver image (image: redwood/gpu-smoke:driver-pinned-540) so we know if it's skew or a test flake? if it passes we can mark as driver-skew and rollback or pin images.
matt: i'll kick a manual run for shard 3 with that image. if it passes, we should add a gating check in premerge matrix to ensure image/driver compatibility.
sylvia: also worth checking the test that allocates a single 40GB tensor — i've seen frag/oom surface as illegal address on mismatch. if rerun fails, i'll bisect recent infra changes.
ci-bot: Manual run started: https://ci.redwood/manual/4287/shard3?image=driver-pinned-540
anya: thanks — if that still fails, please capture `nvidia-smi -q` and `cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version` from the runner and paste here.
raj: noted. i can also spin a node locally and reproduce with the exact image + host driver combo.
infra-bot: update: manual run passed on pinned image. (gpu-smoke/fast shard 3) :white_check_mark:
anya: great — looks like driver/runtime skew. i'll open an infra ticket to coordinate a controlled driver rollout and add a premerge check. assigning to @raj for next steps.
matt: thanks everyone. quick follow-up: let's add a small note to the PR checklist about forcing a rerun if CI hits a driver-related kernel Xid in the logs. :thumbsup:
sylvia: +1. also adding a short test that prints nvidia-smi header at test startup so we have the info in the job logs next time.
anya: adding that to #4287, will cc infra.
